requirements.requirement: TIL names lymphocytes located in sampled tumour tissue, not one lineage, target or functional state.
The fictional count has exactly 100 lymphocytes, with 30 CD8 and 70 others: 30/100 is 30 percent of counted lymphocytes, not all tissue cells or an area percentage.

The breast stromal-TIL method uses eligible tumour-associated stromal area and mononuclear infiltrate including lymphocytes/plasma cells; malignant nests and method-defined excluded tissue do not become the denominator, and it is not a CD8 count.
The separate fictional 0.4/2 square-millimetre area example gives 20 percent; it is a different measurement from 30/100 counted lymphocytes and neither proves useful killing.

The shared fictional unequal-region area map pools (0.4+0.6)/(4+1)=20 percent, whereas an unweighted mean of 10 and 60 percent is 35 percent. This is denominator reasoning, not a mandatory pixel workflow or independent patient data.
Identity, location, cancer specificity and useful function need different measurements. Presence in a tissue section is a snapshot, not evidence that every cell recognizes or kills cancer.

Retain specimen, treatment context, compartment, method, units and denominator. Area, cells per area and cell fractions are not interchangeable, and no universal beneficial-TIL threshold or therapy-selection rule follows.
Inflamed, excluded and desert describe specified cells in sampled tissue regions; define what cold means because its use varies.

The matched fictional fields contain eight specified T-cell symbols in both inflamed and excluded scenes at different locations, and two in the desert scene. These are schematic symbols, not frequencies, cutoffs or measured effect sizes.

State the cell identity and cancer/stroma regions. T-cell symbols do not represent every immune population; a macrophage-rich region or a marker alone does not define T-cell inflammation or suppression.
An excluded distribution does not identify its cause. Region outlines are not a collagen wall; vessels, matrix, recruitment and other hypotheses require their own evidence.
A sampled field does not classify every region, lesion or patient. Site, sampling time, tissue preparation and method constrain the observation.
Equal counts can coexist with different distributions. These symbol counts cannot be converted into a stromal-area TIL score and establish no receptor target, killing or drug benefit.
The fictional primary-tumour fields are not lymph-node follicles or a TLS drawing. Native lymphoid architecture, ectopic organisation and a loose cluster are distinct contexts.
Baseline HLA-I display and an induced response to interferon gamma are different measurements; failure to increase display does not establish absent baseline display.

The fictional baseline control/model each show two complexes; after matched exposure the control shows four and the deficient model retains two. Counts are visual bookkeeping, not molecules measured or a twofold empirical effect.

The right culture is a functionally characterised JAK2-deficient model, not proof that any observed sequence variant causes loss of function; selected melanoma models are not all cancers or a prevalence estimate.

A schematic class-I complex has a membrane-spanning heavy chain, extracellular B2M and peptide cargo in an outward groove. Generic total display and two peptide colours do not identify one target epitope.

Matched exposure, handling and viable appearance constrain the fictional comparison. Stimulus arrows terminate in the outer culture space rather than implying direct cytokine-to-HLA conversion or a complete JAK/STAT pathway.
Do not equate JAK1 with JAK2, inducibility loss with B2M loss, or HLA reduction with automatic NK-cell killing. No clinical rescue or treatment recommendation follows.
T-cell recognition is an unanswered peptide-HLA/receptor question. The conventional two-chain TCR and dashed gap do not demonstrate binding from total HLA abundance.
The tissue-margin scene asks about access, not a proven physical barrier or a guaranteed route into the tissue.
The separate culture and blank killing readout ask about function. Proximity or contact does not demonstrate killing, efficacy or safety.

Baseline display, induced signalling/display, recognition, access and killing are separate endpoints with model, stimulus, time, control and readout attached. One supported step does not certify the rest.
The abscopal observation concerns a response outside an irradiated field; verify exposure and do not silently substitute ablation or an uninjected-lesion label.
Treated-site control is a stated fictional follow-up observation, not guaranteed complete cell killing or future control.

The outside-field lesion needs its own measurement. Local control, delivery or an immune marker alone does not establish distant response; no causal arrow or antigen stream is supplied by the picture.
Concurrent systemic therapy complicates attribution. Even a measured distant response does not isolate radiation's added contribution or establish an immune mechanism.
Local control, distant response, overall disease control, survival and harms are different outcomes; no personal probability or universal response rate follows.
The two-lesion torso and field are schematic, not a complete disease map, anatomical treatment plan, zero-normal-tissue-exposure claim, dose schedule or technique ranking.
Tumour material may be collected by presenting cells; material availability, collection and presentation are conditional jobs rather than an automatic vaccine result.
The injected site, presenting cells, draining lymph node and uninjected lesion are separate compartments. Priming in a node is conditional, not established by a local injection or local injury.
Responders may travel, enter, recognize naturally displayed targets and act; access, recognition and useful function still need their own tests.
Measure each lesion separately. Local size change, immune learning and distant outcome are independent measurements, not successive guaranteed stages.
Uninjected does not mean untreated: a distant lesion can receive systemic or other treatment, affecting attribution.

Local activation and supplied-peptide assay reactivity do not demonstrate natural tumour recognition, whole-body vaccination or clinical benefit. The complete intervention requires suitable comparisons.

The diagram states no clinical success, obligatory route, platform ranking, breast-cancer efficacy transfer, effect size or safety promise. Study/model findings retain their actual populations and evidence tiers.

constructionBoundaries.requirement: All fifteen assigned bodies are read fully at original pin; later entries reuse exact whole-byte identity. Both version inventories remain separate.
Historical PASS, independent-review and original grade labels are preserved claims at their stated scope, not current independent, expert, owner, learner or language acceptance.
Original shared SVG creator identity can be unknown. Task author, derivation actor, navigation generator and reviewer roles must not be reassigned as artwork creator.
Embedded public, candidate/preimage and private hash assertions have distinct meanings. No private historical path is followed or assumed to be a reproducible package.
Duplicate alt/caption strings in provenance are checked against owners; support receipts do not gain independent science or coverage credit from embedding those strings.
Teaching deltas and the immune-map path relocation are explicit. Whole source-file identity, eligible public-body comparison and unchanged figure identity are not conflated.

Historical source-access and whole-paper claims are not inherited as fresh reads. Unselected clinical cohort figures and retained broad mechanistic claims are not newly certified by this asset review.

Twelve whole native views and complete SVG DOM parsing, where performed, are distinct from exact PNG palette-only identity, browser/hydration, physical mobile, quantitative contrast or accessibility acceptance.
Known historical focus-return-to-BODY and outstanding human review limits stay open; no new renderer or deployed-reader approval is implied.

Frontmatter, generated navigation and personal-case sections are excluded from human public-teaching context reads. Source-file identities remain preserved; no private case or treatment decision is copied into public artifacts.
